claim: A discount percentage of 0 is outside the range 1–50 and must return 400.
A discount percentage of 51 is outside the range 1–50 and must return 400.
A discount can only be applied by the owner of the order; any other caller must receive 403.
A discount percentage of 1 is the minimum valid value and must be accepted with a 200 response.
The order total after a discount can never go below 0.
